result.title: Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation
result.summary: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 GRPO 虽提升胸片报告的语言与临床准确性，却对异常识别的视觉表征改善有限，因而提出选择性区域视觉蒸馏：用区域监督训练教师模型，以区域特征替换逐一核验教师特征是否有用，再用空间门控残差适配器只蒸馏已验证特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「VLM 内部状态是否保留任务必要的视觉细节」，其「特征替换核验 + 门控适配以少干扰原表征」可供核查 latent 视觉证据筛选与旧能力保持问题；但无推理期状态生成，跨任务可迁移性仍待阅读全文判断。
